title: Kusanagi Nene — Swept Up In The Edo Streets〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Swept Up In The Edo Streets（2★）

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It really feels like we're back in the Edo period! Right, Nene?! I'm having fun just walking around♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wanted to get a better grasp of my character by walking around like this since we start performing for real tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But Emu's right...
It really feels like we're back in ancient Tokyo.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The buildings and set designs all look authentic. Plus, there's a huge number of staff and guests...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I have to do my best...!
Because this is a huge opportunity for everyone in Mikazukigumi.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene! This way!
Let's check out that dango shop!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, we're at the dango shop!
Wow! The soy sauce they're using smells so good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it does... But are you sure you didn't want to go to any of the other dango shops? This place has a ton of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanted to come here because this shop apparently makes all sorts of different dango!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really?
Come to think of it, they do seem to offer a huge selection...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heehee!
I did some research beforehand♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The other shops seem to specialize in making soy-sauce-flavored or sweet types of dango. They all offer something different...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's like the popcorn they have at Phoenix Wonderland! Some guests make it their mission to try every single flavor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, even though they have this many types...?!
I'd be so full after eating all these...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I could eat lots and lots of them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This place really does feel a lot like Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She might be right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The buildings, set design and overall scale differ a lot compared to Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But they seem to have a lot of things in common...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Girls
rows.Line:
Oh, Sis, look!
That dango shop has lots of different kinds we can choose from!

rows.Speaker: Girls
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right!
I don't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Girls
rows.Line:
Me neither!
But let's see... I still haven't had...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All the guests here seem to be really enjoying themselves. Just like the ones who visit Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're all here because they want to smile and have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The show we're going to do here is just like the ones we used to do back at Phoenix Wonderland.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, we just have to do what we used to do...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our goal will be to perform in a way that allows the guests to make their time here even more enjoyable.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Nene? Is something the matter...?
Your eyes look like they're on fire...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... It's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, I actually am a little hungry.
I could really go for some of these dango now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, that's what I like to hear!
In that case, I'll buy you one of each kind☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? No, I don't think that's...
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
I'd like to buy some of your dango!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome!
You seem awfully energetic.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu, wait!
Geez...
